title: Meta’s New 30B AI Agent Runs Locally Without a Subscription
description: While everyone is moving to Claude, Meta made a surprising move. It released a 30B-parameter AI agent that can run locally, work offline, and understand screenshots, charts, and documents—without a subscription or token limits.
